verdict.rationale: Datalab is an API-first product. It has a documented public API reference covering convert, structured extraction, segmentation, document creation, running agent processors, schema generation, and health checks. Supporting this are webhooks with per-request overrides, a Python SDK, a CLI, and an llms.txt index that makes the docs agent-friendly. missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (probes of common paths returned 404), independent or hands-on corroboration of the hosted API (community reports cover only the open-source Marker and Chandra).
